item.title: Briefing — Wednesday 18 November 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Today is leg day, and the sky has not skipped it. Seven to twelve degrees, forty-six millimetres of rain, wind seven. Thursday is the second set, twenty-four millimetres. Friday is the rest day, a tenth of a millimetre, enjoy it. Saturday is the cool-down: clear, dry,…

item.title: Briefing — Wednesday 11 November 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Seven to nine, nearly ten millimetres of rain, so today the sky is still wearing its duvet and sweating through it. Then Thursday it throws the duvet off. Clear, dry, three to seven, and clear skies mean nothing holds the heat in, so dawn hits zero Friday and minus two…

item.title: Briefing — Tuesday 17 November 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Today is the sale preview, and the sky has not even opened the doors. Eight to twelve degrees, five point six millimetres, wind nine. Then the clearance sale starts: Wednesday seventy-six point four millimetres, Thursday forty-three point six. A hundred and twenty…

item.title: Briefing — Tuesday 10 November 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Cloudy, four to ten, and nearly nineteen millimetres of rain. Wednesday adds another twelve at a flat seven to nine, so wellies, proper coat, and fog lights, because London has a pollution alert for fog this morning. Then Thursday and Friday go clear and bone dry,…

item.title: Briefing — Thursday 19 November 2026
item.description:
Weather.
The next three days are dry but cold, four to ten today and down to freezing by Saturday dawn. The clouds will look stormy and never deliver, so you will take the umbrella all three days and regret it every time.
Here are the biggest news stories and how they connect.…

item.title: Briefing — Thursday 12 November 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Two to seven, clear, dry. Lovely. Enjoy it, because this is the free trial. Friday, clear, dry, dawn around zero. Saturday, still dry, minus two at dawn, so de-ice like an adult. Then Sunday auto-renews: nearly five millimetres, four to eleven, with a drizzle fee…

item.title: Briefing — Sunday 15 November 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Box set weekend, and you are bingeing it whether you like it or not. Episode one, today: two to ten degrees, twenty-five point three millimetres, wind six. Episode two, Monday: four to six degrees, thirty-two point five millimetres, the wettest and coldest, naturally…

item.title: Briefing — Sunday 08 November 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Today five to seven, cloudy, a token drizzle, no personality whatsoever. Monday is five to ten and bone dry, a free pass, so enjoy it, you ungrateful lump. Then Tuesday. Twenty-four point two millimetres. The sky has been saving up and Tuesday is it emptying the piggy…

item.title: Briefing — Saturday 21 November 2026
item.description:
Weather.
The next three days are dry: two to eight degrees today, four to eight Sunday under cloud, two to six Monday and clear. Every dry day removes an excuse for not clearing the gutters, and you will invent a fresh one by lunchtime.
Here are the biggest news stories and…

item.title: Briefing — Saturday 14 November 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Last orders. Today is the final dry day: minus two at dawn, up to eight, no rain, light wind. Use it or lose it. Wash the car, hang the washing, ring your mother. Because at closing time the sky buys everyone a round. Sunday, nineteen point three millimetres, wind…

item.title: Briefing — Saturday 07 November 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Today four to ten, cloudy, bone dry, so the wet Saturday evaporated and you lose your excuse. Sunday and Monday copy it, Monday dawning at two degrees, the coldest of the week. Then the rain applies for a job. Tuesday is the intern, one point three millimetres.…

item.title: Briefing — Monday 16 November 2026
item.description:
Weather.
The sky has spent the weekend running up a bill and today it sends the apology, in instalments. Today: two to seven degrees, twenty-six point two millimetres, wind six. Tuesday is the big grovel, thirty-eight point eight millimetres, four to twelve, the wettest day of…

item.title: Briefing — Monday 09 November 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Fog this morning, so the school run is a blindfold game. Today four to nine, dry, partly cloudy, enjoy it, you will not be given another. Because Tuesday the sky leaves the bath running. Fifty-four and a half millimetres Tuesday, forty-eight Wednesday, over a hundred…

item.title: Briefing — Friday 20 November 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Today two to nine degrees, partly cloudy, half a millimetre of rain, which is not rain, that is the sky clearing its throat. Coat, scarf, and yes, you. Saturday dawn dips to freezing, so the car becomes a block of ice and you chip at it like an archaeologist whose…

item.title: Briefing — Friday 13 November 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Friday the thirteenth, and a doomsday study says the world ends today. It fails, because the forecast is dry. Zero to seven, clear, no rain. Saturday the same, minus one at dawn, so scrape the car like an adult. Then Sunday ruins it. Yesterday I said nearly five…
